# Bundle Fixtures

`valid.msixbundle` and `corrupt.msixbundle` are synthetic test-only packages
generated alongside the ms-package bundle tests. Both declare x64 and arm64
nested packages with matching identities. The corrupt fixture changes the x64
payload without updating its block-map hash; the arm64 package remains valid.

The valid payload is `portable package payload\n`. These fixtures contain no
third-party payloads or trusted signatures.

The synthetic `external.msi` uses `data.cab` through an explicit resolver mapping.
`missing-second.msi` contains one valid embedded payload, then references a missing
external cabinet for the second file to test operation-wide provisional output.
These were generated by `../ms-package/examples/browser_fixtures.rs`.
